names.name: Decontee
notes: Dekonti is found in all the Kru language family languages (formerly / erroneously known as KWA) in Liberia. Kru, Bassa, Krahn, and Grebo all have variations of the name Decontee / Dekonti. Ti - time, kon - everything, De - possesses (in some languages De and Kon take different meanings).
